dependencies: Cargo.lock lists only workspace path packages, so the build reads no registry or git dependency.

environment.cargoHome: The user's existing ~/.cargo, shared by both builds. It supplies no package sources for this build.
environment.host: macOS arm64 running x86_64 tools under Rosetta 2
environment.linker: Apple ld-1267 from Command Line Tools
environment.rustInstall: A separate RUSTUP_HOME whose default host is x86_64-apple-darwin, run under Rosetta 2

inputs: payload.json lists every repository input file with its byte count and SHA-256. assembly.json binds the CLI request, compiler response, generated CLI Rust, recipe and executable.
